label: dormwarsfive5
title_zh: 无才又话痨！问答大混战！

lines.en: label dormwarsfive5:
scene sky
A short while later, Imani begins rounding up each straggling girl and sending them over to the library for the next competition.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，Imani 开始把一个个掉队的女生收拢起来，赶去图书馆参加下一场比赛。

lines.en: Miku, who initially attempts to hide behind me in a rare act of non-sexual submission, is one of the first to be culled — followed by Yasu and her unofficial caretaker.
lines.zh: Miku 一开始试图躲到我身后——这可是她难得一次非性方面的顺从——结果是最早被清走的那一批，紧接着是 Yasu 和她那位非官方的监护者。

lines.en: Eventually, it’s just Makoto and me left in the cafeteria. And while she absolutely would have sex with me right now (and probably wants to), I figure I should save that for later.
lines.zh: 最后，食堂里只剩下 Makoto 和我。虽然她现在绝对愿意和我上床（大概也想），但我觉得那还是留到以后吧。

lines.en: Would it be both nice and fitting to copulate with the student council president on my first day back to school in god God knows how long? Of course.
lines.zh: 在时隔上帝 God 才知道多久之后重返学校的第一天，和学生会主席交媾，既美好又应景吧？当然。

lines.en: But that also runs the risk of having her get in trouble if we’re caught. Which is a thing that-
lines.zh: 但那也有风险——万一被抓到，她会惹上麻烦。而那件事——

lines.en: Actually, I doubt she’d care much at this point.
lines.zh: 其实，我怀疑她现在已经不太在乎了。

lines.en: But that’s because she’s turning into me. And that’s about 90%% my fault and 10%% the world’s for throwing her into a situation she can’t escape from.
lines.zh: 但那是因为她正在变成我。而这大约 90%% 是我的错，10%% 是这个世界的错，是它把她扔进了一个她无法逃脱的处境。

lines.en: Which is...also coincidentally what I have done.
lines.zh: 而那……碰巧也是我做的事。

lines.en: Either way, the two of us begin to head over to the library for what I’m sure will be the worst trivia contest of all time. But I stop her several steps in by grabbing her hand.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们俩动身前往图书馆，去参加我有史以来最糟糕的一场问答比赛。但走了几步，我抓住她的手，让她停下。

lines.en: She looks up at me, confused. And I look down at her, also confused.
lines.zh: 她抬头看我，一脸困惑。我低头看她，同样困惑。

lines.en: But then I lean down and kiss her and things make a little more sense.
lines.zh: 然后我俯身吻了她，于是事情稍微说得通了一点。

lines.en: : Wha-
: I’m sorry I can’t be here to suffer with you as much as you want me to be.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我没法如你所愿地留在这里陪你一起受苦。

lines.en: : I’m too busy just suffering on my own now.
lines.zh: : 我现在光是自己受苦就够忙的了。

lines.en: : Hah...
lines.zh: : 哈啊……

lines.en: : Is it more because you can’t live with the things you’ve done? Or because you know you can’t escape them in a world that won’t stop reminding you?
lines.zh: : 更多是因为你无法和自己做过的事共存？还是因为你知道，在一个不断提醒你的世界里，你逃不掉它们？

lines.en: : Both.
lines.zh: : 两者都有。

lines.en: : I have a few less regrets when it comes to you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过对你，我的悔恨要少一些。

lines.en: : Oh? Is that because I told you you shouldn’t feel bad about having sex with me since we’ve known each other for probably millions of years now?
lines.zh: : 哦？是因为我告诉过你，不必为和我上床而感到愧疚，毕竟我们大概已经认识几百万年了吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I just know I have you tightly secured to an infinite leash now. And I like that.
lines.zh: : 不完全是。我只是知道，我现在已经把你紧紧拴在一根无限长的绳子上了。而我喜欢那样。

lines.en: : Hm. Well, I was hoping to be your lover if this all boils over. But I guess being your dog isn’t as bad as being forgotten.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我本来还希望，等这一切收场之后能当你的情人。不过当你的狗，大概总比被遗忘要好。

lines.en: She kisses me this time, but she needs to grab my collar to pull me down to her level for it.
lines.zh: 这次是她吻我，但她得抓住我的衣领，把我拉到她的高度才够得着。

lines.en: : Come on, Sensei. We need to go watch a train wreck.
lines.zh: : 走了，Sensei。我们得去看一场车祸现场了。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia1
: At the start of the third game, the score of this year’s Dorm Wars is currently tied with a score of one to one!
lines.zh: : 第三场比赛开始时，本届宿舍战争的比分目前是一比一平！

lines.en: : It’s been a heated battle so far! Hasn’t it, Uta?!
lines.zh: : 到目前为止战况激烈！是吧，Uta？！

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia2
: It sure has, Ayane! It’s only been two hours and we’ve already made one whole omelet and then sat at a table and roleplayed Shrek!
lines.zh: : 那当然，Ayane！才过了两个小时，我们就已经做出了一整份煎蛋卷，然后围着桌子把《怪物史莱克》演了一遍！

lines.en: : So not as heated as I made it sound!
lines.zh: : 所以没我说得那么激烈！

lines.en: : But still heated regardless!
lines.zh: : 但不管怎样还是很激烈！

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia3
: Because today is the day that all of us girls will become women.
lines.zh: : 因为今天，是我们所有女生变成女人的日子。

lines.en: : Today is the day where weaknesses become strengths! When we learn which floor is truly the most versatile and admirable!
lines.zh: : 今天是弱点化为强项的日子！我们将看到哪一层楼才是真正最多才多艺、最值得敬佩的！

lines.en: : At least until next year when we do this all over again.
lines.zh: : 至少到明年我们再重来一遍之前是这样。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia4
: Hi. I have a question.
lines.zh: : 嗨。我有个问题。

lines.en: : Yes, Miku! What’s up?
lines.zh: : 说吧，Miku！怎么了？

lines.en: : Why do you hate me?
lines.zh: : 你们为什么讨厌我？

lines.en: : Nobody hates you, Miku!
lines.zh: : 没人讨厌你，Miku！

lines.en: : Yeah! Like half of the class is being put up against each other in stuff they’re bad at.
lines.zh: : 就是啊！全班有一半人都在被安排去比各自不擅长的东西。

lines.en: : And we’ve already learned through Chika and Kirin’s contest that this can actually be a good thing for you guys!
lines.zh: : 而且我们已经从 Chika 和 Kirin 的比赛里学到，这对你们来说其实是件好事！

lines.en: : Right! Like maybe today will be the inspiration you need to start doing better in school?
lines.zh: : 对！也许今天会成为你需要的动力，让你开始好好学习？

lines.en: : Or maybe I’ll just make myself look like the 2024 Chicago White Sox goin’ up against the Dodgers while Ohtani’s on the mound.
lines.zh: : 也可能我会让自己看起来像 2024 年的芝加哥白袜队，在 Ohtani 站上投手丘的时候对上道奇队。

lines.en: : I wish Io was here. She’d be really proud of you right now. Also, I’m pretty sure this is the second year in a row we’ve brought up Ohtani during a library trivia contest.
lines.zh: : 真希望 Io 在。她现在一定会为你骄傲。还有，我敢肯定这已经是我们连续第二年在图书馆问答比赛里提到 Ohtani 了。

lines.en: : She’d also be here to tell you that Ohtani didn’t pitch in 2024 due to a UCL injury.
lines.zh: : 她还会在这儿告诉你，Ohtani 因为尺侧副韧带受伤，2024 年没有投球。

lines.en: : Just do your best, Miku. Complaining will only delay the inevitable at this point.
lines.zh: : 尽力就好，Miku。抱怨只会推迟那个不可避免的结局。

lines.en: : Yeah. We’re all rooting for you. And it’s not just because the fate of this contest sort of lies in your hands right now. It’s because we like you.
lines.zh: : 就是啊。我们都在为你加油。不只是因为这场比赛的命运现在多少掌握在你手里。是因为我们喜欢你。

lines.en: : Also because the fate of this contest sort of lies in your hands right now.
lines.zh: : 也因为这场比赛的命运现在多少掌握在你手里。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia5
: I apologize in advance for my inferior intellect.
lines.zh: : 我为我低下的智力提前道歉。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia6
: Well, that was a good start at least. “Inferior” is much bigger word than I’ve come to expect from you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少开头不错。「低下」这个词可比我印象中你会用的词大多了。

lines.en: : One that perfectly encapsulates who we are as human beings in a world that belongs to God.
lines.zh: : 一个完美概括了人类在属于上帝的世界里是何等存在的词。

lines.en: : Also, I can’t imagine you’re at much of a disadvantage if at all right now.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得你现在的劣势就算有，也没多大。

lines.en: : Is it just me or is Yasu kind of cute today?
lines.zh: : 是我多心了，还是 Yasu 今天有点可爱？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia7
: Yasu is always cute in a...Yasu way. But if you’re referring to her wardrobe, you can thank a team of professional stylists for that.
lines.zh: : Yasu 一直都很可爱，是一种……Yasu 式的可爱。不过如果你说的是她的穿搭，那得感谢一整支专业造型师团队。

lines.en: : And Molly helped me with my hair. Do you like it, Sensei? Do I look like a normal girl now?
lines.zh: : 头发是 Molly 帮我弄的。你喜欢吗，Sensei？我现在看起来像个普通女生了吗？

lines.en: : Yes, and it’s making me very uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 喜欢，而那让我非常不自在。

lines.en: : Eyes over here, Dad.
lines.zh: : 眼睛看这边，爸爸。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia8
: I’ll just stare at the ground and be ashamed of myself.
lines.zh: : 那我就盯着地板，为自己感到羞耻吧。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I’m uncomfortable too. And I imagine Nodoka is in the same boat as well given that she is the biggest sex demon of all.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我也挺不自在的。而且我猜 Nodoka 也是同样的处境，毕竟她是所有人里最大的性欲恶魔。

lines.en: : I wonder if Futaba would hug me?
lines.zh: : 我在想 Futaba 会不会抱我呢？

lines.en: : Or she’s still hung up on hugs for some reason.
lines.zh: : 或者她只是因为某种原因还执着于拥抱这件事。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia9
: The rules of the game are simple — and we’re only going to ask that you answer five total questions correctly before granting your floor the victory.
lines.zh: : 比赛规则很简单——我们只需要你们答对总共五道题，就能为本楼层赢得胜利。

lines.en: : Five?! We’ve gotta know five whole things?!
lines.zh: : 五道？！我们得知道整整五件事？！

lines.en: : At least tell me the questions are gonna be from categories we’re good at! Like, ask me somethin’ about soccer! Or One Piece! Pokemon! Anything but math!
lines.zh: : 至少告诉我题目会出在我们擅长的类别里！比如问我点足球的事！或者《海贼王》！宝可梦！除了数学什么都行！

lines.en: : I don’t think we have any math questions, so you don’t have to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 我想我们没有数学题，所以你不用担心那个。

lines.en: : Oh, thank the friggin’ lord.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia10
: So anyway, our first trivia question is about molecular biology and it’s for Miku.
lines.zh: : 那么，我们的第一道问答题是关于分子生物学的，由 Miku 作答。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia11
: AAAAAH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : Jeez. We’re starting off with something like that already?
lines.zh: : 天哪。一上来就出这种题？

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, what happens if neither contestant is ever able to answer a single question correctly?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇问一下，如果两位选手一道题都答不对，会怎么样？

lines.en: : Then we stay here forever, Maya! And Sensei has to rebuild civilization from the ground up since he’s the only boy in the room.
lines.zh: : 那我们就永远留在这儿了，Maya！而 Sensei 得从零开始重建文明，因为他是这屋里唯一的男生。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia12
: It’s a dirty job, but someone’s gotta do it.
lines.zh: : 这活儿脏，但总得有人干。

lines.en: : Start with me. Then also end with me. Because I am all you need and, coincidentally, all you want as well.
lines.zh: : 从我开始。也以我结束。因为我就是你需要的一切，而且碰巧也是你想要的一切。

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia13
: Sorry, Miss Imai. That was probably rude of me. You can watch, don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Imai 老师。我刚才可能有点失礼了。你可以看，别担心。

lines.en: : Ayane, just ask the damn question before I have to slap a bitch.
lines.zh: : Ayane，在我扇某个贱人之前，把那该死的问题问出来。

lines.en: : Miku! What covalent bonds link nucleic acid monomers?
lines.zh: : Miku！连接核酸单体的共价键叫什么？

lines.en: : Miku! What covalent bonds link nucleic acid monomers?
lines.zh: : Miku！连接核酸单体的共价键叫什么？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia14
: Regis, I think I’d like to phone a friend.
lines.zh: : Regis，我想打个电话给朋友。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia15
: Okay! So Miku passes and now Yasu gets to go!
lines.zh: : 好！那么 Miku 放弃，现在轮到 Yasu！

lines.en: : Remember, Yasu — it is okay to not know these things and it is okay to say “pass” if you feel yourself getting stuck.
lines.zh: : 记住，Yasu——不知道这些东西没关系，如果你觉得自己卡住了，说「过」也没关系。

lines.en: : Because, based on the question Miku received, we can assume that the hosts are not holding back and will be quizzing you on topics not yet touched upon by-
lines.zh: : 因为从 Miku 拿到的题来看，我们可以假定主持人没有手下留情，会拿你们还没接触过的话题来考你——

lines.en: : What is a duck?
lines.zh: : 鸭子是什么？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia16
: ...I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: : Sorry, was I not loud enough? Yasu! What is a duck?!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我声音不够大吗？Yasu！鸭子是什么？！

lines.en: : The heck is this rigged nonsense?! Y’all are gonna give me a friggin’ testicular biography question and Yasu just needs to tell you what a duck is?!
lines.zh: : 这他妈是什么黑幕？！你们给我出一道他妈的睾丸传记题，Yasu 只要告诉你们鸭子是什么就行？！

lines.en: : This does seem a little unfair, and I’m on Yasu’s team.
lines.zh: : 这确实有点不公平，而我可是 Yasu 这边的。

lines.en: : It’s okay, Miku. I’m sure that Yasu’s next question will be difficult and yours will be about describing some other sort of animal.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Miku。我相信 Yasu 的下一题会很难，而你那题会是描述另一种动物。

lines.en: : Friggin’ better be! I need all the help I can get here!
lines.zh: : 他妈的最好是！我现在需要一切能得到的帮助！

lines.en: : Okay, Yasu. Do not squander this opportunity. Answer the question and briskly move onto the next.
lines.zh: : 好了，Yasu。别浪费这个机会。回答问题，然后迅速进入下一题。

lines.en: : Pass.
scene mikuyasutrivia17
: Pass?!
: Did I make a mistake? You said it was okay to pass if I felt myself getting stuck, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我做错了吗？你说过如果我觉得卡住了，可以过，Touka。

lines.en: : She wasn’t asking you for the scientific classification of a duck! She mentioned no genus! You just had to say it was a little wet bird with a little orange beak!
lines.zh: : 她又没问你鸭子的科学分类！她根本没提属名！你只要说那是一只长着橙色小喙的、湿漉漉的小鸟就行了！

lines.en: : I wanted to, Touka. But what I struggle to understand is that little bird’s importance in the grand scheme of His divine schedule.
lines.zh: : 我想说的，Touka。但我难以理解的是，那只小鸟在祂神圣的时间表中究竟有何重要性。

lines.en: : What if there is more to the duck that I have yet to grasp as but a fledgling myself?
lines.zh: : 如果那只鸭子还有我尚未领会的深意，而我自己也不过是一只羽翼未丰的雏鸟呢？

lines.en: : Would reducing its potential to mere visual characteristics not doom the creature to a life of being misunderstood the way that I, too, have my purpose misconstrued?
lines.zh: : 把它的可能性降格为纯粹的视觉特征，岂不是注定要让这生灵一生都被误解，就像我的使命也一直被人曲解那样？

lines.en: : Yes! If that’s what wins us the contest!
lines.zh: : 对！只要那样能让我们赢就行！

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia18
: Wow, Ayane. You were spot-on when you predicted that Yasu would struggle with simple questions like that.
lines.zh: : 哇，Ayane。你之前预言 Yasu 会在这种简单问题上卡壳，还真是说中了。

lines.en: : And you were spot on when you assumed Miku would struggle with difficult questions.
lines.zh: : 而你猜 Miku 会在难题上卡壳，也猜得一点不差。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I don’t believe that’s something worth being impressed about.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我觉得那不是什么值得佩服的事。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia19
: Probably not! But I’m a nice person who says nice things whenever possible!
lines.zh: : 大概吧！但我是个好人，只要有机会就说好话！

lines.en: : Which is why I’ll compliment Miku on her hair before asking her this next question so she doesn’t feel as bad when she gets it wrong.
lines.zh: : 所以我要在问下一题之前先夸夸 Miku 的头发，好让她答错的时候不那么难受。

lines.en: : Nice hair, Miku! What is the study of knowledge called?
lines.zh: : 头发很漂亮，Miku！研究知识的学科叫什么？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia20
: Learning!
lines.zh: : 学习！

lines.en: : Hah...
lines.zh: : 哈啊……

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia21
: What?! How is that wrong?! Ain’t that the whole point of learning?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！这哪里错了？！学习不就是这么回事吗？！

lines.en: : Technically it...kind of is? But we were looking for the specific study of knowledge. Not a broad description of how learning is the act of absorbing it.
lines.zh: : 从技术上说……算是吧？但我们要的是专门研究知识的学科。不是「学习是吸收知识的行为」这种宽泛的描述。

lines.en: : Can we give her another guess, Uta? Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 我们能让她再猜一次吗，Uta？可以吗？

lines.en: : Imani! Check the rule book!
lines.zh: : Imani！查规则手册！

lines.en: : There’s nothing about this in the rule book, but I say give her another shot. We might be in here for a while if we don’t.
lines.zh: : 规则手册里没写这个，但我说再给她一次机会吧。不然我们可能要在这儿待很久。

lines.en: : Miku! Do you have a second guess?
lines.zh: : Miku！你有第二个答案吗？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia22
: Uhh...well...
: The study of meteors is called meteorology, so...knowledgeology?...Maybe?...
lines.zh: : 研究流星的叫流星学，所以……知识学？……大概？……

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia23
: The study of meteors is not called meteorology, Miku! Where in the world did you even hear that?!
lines.zh: : 研究流星的不叫流星学，Miku！你到底是从哪儿听来的？！

lines.en: : The TV obviously! They’re talkin’ about it all the time!
lines.zh: : 当然是电视上啊！他们天天都在说！

lines.en: : Because meteorology is the study of weather! You’re probably watching the weather report!
lines.zh: : 因为气象学是研究天气的！你八成是在看天气预报！

lines.en: : Are you tellin’ me I’ve been livin’ in fear for nothing?!
lines.zh: : 你是说我这些年一直白白活在恐惧里？！

lines.en: : Have you been expecting meteors to fall every time the rain is mentioned?!
lines.zh: : 每次提到下雨，你都在等着流星砸下来吗？！

lines.en: : Obviously not, Makoto! The meteors block the rain!
lines.zh: : 当然不是，Makoto！是流星挡住了雨！

lines.en: : I feel like we should probably take a point away from Miku now. But she doesn’t have any, so...Yasu!
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们现在大概该扣 Miku 一分了。但她一分都没有，所以……Yasu！

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia24
: What is a horse?
lines.zh: : 马是什么？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia25
: Mm! Touka, this game is too hard! I don’t know how to do it!
lines.zh: : 嗯！Touka，这游戏太难了！我不知道该怎么玩！

lines.en: : Well, I will be of little assistance here as that is a question without a simple answer. And one that would take years to respond to completely.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，我帮不上什么忙，因为这个问题没有简单的答案。要完整回答大概要花上好几年。

lines.en: : I suggest you pass here as well, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我建议你这题也过吧，Yasu。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia26
: Uta and Ayane, I apologize for my incessant inadequacy and understand that the sight of me is likely to induce nausea. But could you please ask me an easier question?
lines.zh: : Uta、Ayane，我为自己无尽的无能道歉，也理解看到我大概会让人作呕。但你们能问个简单点的题吗？

lines.en: : Same here! Just replace the nausea thing with pity or somethin’ cause y’all got them crazy milkers and I ain’t even got a cup to hold ‘em in.
lines.zh: : 我也是！不过把作呕换成同情什么的就行，毕竟你们有着那对疯狂的奶子，而我连个装它们的罩子都没有。

lines.en: : Ami and Maya get it. Right, girls?
lines.zh: : Ami 和 Maya 懂的。对吧，两位？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia27
: Not really. My body is perfect. What envy should I have for those who will grow up with back problems?
lines.zh: : 不太懂。我的身材是完美的。我为什么要嫉妒那些长大后会腰疼的人？

lines.en: : I’ll gladly accept whatever size increase Maya is supposed to get in the future and split it with Miku. With some more help, we may even wind up with B’s.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意把 Maya Miku该长的那份尺寸接过来，再分给 Miku 一半。再多帮点忙，我们说不定能有 B 罩杯。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia28
: A girl can friggin’ dream. Maybe one day, Ami. Maybe one day.
lines.zh: : 人总得有点梦想。也许有一天吧，Ami。也许有一天。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia29
: Uta, are you thinking what I’m thinking?
lines.zh: : Uta，你在想我正想着的事吗？

lines.en: : You mean about boobs? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 你是说胸部？是的。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia30
: No, about how we might have made this contest a little too difficult.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说这场比赛我们可能出得太难了。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well yeah, now I’m thinking about that instead.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧，那我现在想的又是那个了。

lines.en: : What do you think we should do then? Stick to the plan? Or maybe change things up a bit and ask them questions they might actually be able to answer?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得我们该怎么办？照原计划走？还是稍微改改，问点她们真能答上来的题？

lines.en: : The latter would probably be ideal since we’ve still gotta fit Sensei into a couple girls who want to be nice to him.
lines.zh: : 后者应该更理想，毕竟我们还得把 Sensei 塞进几个想对他好的女生中间去。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia31
: No. Try again.
lines.zh: : 不。再想。

lines.en: : The schedule. We’ve gotta make sure it happens and stuff.
lines.zh: : 日程。我们得确保流程走完之类的。

lines.en: : Okay, good. Cause what Uta said is impossible and I ain’t fightin’ two losin’ battles in one day.
lines.zh: : 行，好。因为 Uta 说的那个是不可能的，我可不想一天之内打两场必输的仗。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Let’s cool it with all the innuendos and tone it down a bit, alright?
lines.zh: : 好了好了。都收一收那些黄色玩笑，收敛一点，好吗？

lines.en: : Ayane, Uta — it was nice stumping them, but let’s stick to easier stuff for now. Nobody wants to spend the rest of their day here.
lines.zh: : Ayane、Uta——把她们难住是挺有意思，但现在还是出简单点的吧。没人想在这儿耗掉一整天。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind.
lines.zh: : 我倒是无所谓。

lines.en: : Yeah, same. The longer we can postpone being nice to Sensei, the better.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也是。能拖多久不对 Sensei 好，就拖多久。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia32
: I am so loved.
lines.zh: : 我可真受欢迎啊。

lines.en: : Could be worse!
lines.zh: : 还可能更糟呢！

lines.en: mak "One of them could be permanently mean to you because it was a precedent established early on in your relationship! And because
lines.zh: mak "其中一个可能会永远对你刻薄，因为那是你们关系早期就定下的先例！而且因为

lines.en: changing the way they act now would be detrimental to the dynamic of you as characters! Which is why it gets super confusing when they suddenly start doing nice things!"
lines.zh: 现在改变她们的相处方式，会损害你们作为角色之间的互动！这就是为什么当她们突然开始做些好事的时候，会让人格外困惑！"

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia33
: You’re literally describing Maya. That’s what Maya is.
lines.zh: : 你说的简直就是在描述 Maya。Maya 就是那样。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia34
: Yeah. I’m kind of the Babe Ruth of being mean to that useless sack of adolescent fury that never managed to blossom into a fully-grown man.
lines.zh: : 对。在对那个永远没能长成完整男人的、装满青春期愤怒的废物麻袋刻薄这件事上，我大概算是贝比·鲁斯级别。

lines.en: : Again, where is Io when people start breaking out the baseball stuff?
lines.zh: : 又来了，一到有人开始扯棒球，Io 在哪儿啊？

lines.en: : Probably with some friggin’ wood in her hands.
lines.zh: : 大概手里正拿着什么他妈的木头吧。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia35
: Well, that’d be a twist. Anyway! I’m gonna start lookin’ up some new questions so we can eventually get outta here.
lines.zh: : 那可真是个转折。总之！我要开始找些新题目，好让我们最终能离开这儿。

lines.en: : Way ahead of you, Uta! I’ve got Miku’s first “fair” question ready to go right now! I’m sure this contest will be over any minute!
lines.zh: : 我已经抢先了，Uta！我为 Miku 准备的第一道「公平」题现在就可以上！我敢肯定这场比赛随时就能结束！

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia36
One hour later...
lines.zh: 一小时之后……

lines.en: : The score...
lines.zh: : 比分……

lines.en: : Is zero to zero...
lines.zh: : 是零比零……

lines.en: : I didn’t realize it was possible to be this dumb. No offense, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我不知道人还能笨到这种程度。无意冒犯，Yasu。

lines.en: : Wh-What about Miku?!
lines.zh: : 那……那 Miku 呢？！

lines.en: : I want to offend Miku. If we were asking Yasu the same questions we’re asking you, she’d have won by now.
lines.zh: : 我就是想冒犯 Miku。要是我们问 Yasu 的是给你出的那些题，她早就赢了。

lines.en: : Oh yeah?! Then go ahead, Ayane! Ask her the last one you gave me! Let’s see how she handles it!
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？！那你来啊，Ayane！问她你最后给我出的那道！看她怎么应付！

lines.en: : Yasu, what color are Yumi’s eyes?
lines.zh: : Yasu，Yumi 的眼睛是什么颜色？

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia37
: G...Gray...ish?...
: Ding ding ding! Close enough! Yasu wins and it’s time to move on! Excellent work to everyone! Just not really! Like, really not really!
lines.zh: : 叮叮叮！差不多算对！Yasu 获胜，是时候进入下一项了！大家干得漂亮！其实也不是！真的，真的不是！

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia38
: I did it? Really?
lines.zh: : 我做到了？真的吗？

lines.en: : Heck nah! She’s makin’ it up! Ain’t anybody seen Yumi long enough to figure out what color her eyes are! That’s like askin’ what a ghost feels like.
lines.zh: : 他妈的才怪！她在瞎编！根本没人见过 Yumi 久到能弄清她眼睛是什么颜色！那就像在问鬼魂摸起来是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia39
: Ghosts feel wonderful. Or at least I think that’s what you would call them if you could see the world like me.
lines.zh: : 鬼魂摸起来很美妙。至少我觉得，如果你能像我一样看见那个世界，你就会这么形容。

lines.en: : Their touch is like a cold, ethereal emptiness that is both all-consuming and mercilessly generous. I can show you if you close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 它们的触碰像一种冰冷而空灵的虚无，既吞噬一切，又慷慨得无情。你闭上眼睛，我可以让你看看。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia40
: O...kaaaaay. But even if she got her last question right, that’s still only one! The game was supposed to go up to five!
lines.zh: : 哦……好……吧。不过就算她最后一题答对了，那也只有一分啊！比赛本来是要打到五分的！

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia41
: We really just don’t have all day, Miku. If it makes you feel better, we can play the rest of the game in the hotel later.
lines.zh: : 我们真的没有一整天，Miku。如果这样能让你好受点，我们可以晚上在酒店把剩下的比完。

lines.en: : And cut into my time of not engagin’ in knowledgeology? Wanna hear my Yasu impression? Pass.
lines.zh: : 然后占用我不去搞知识学的时间？想听听我模仿 Yasu 吗？过。

lines.en: : The Dorm Wars is still just 30%% complete, Miku. We have plenty of time to mount a comeback.
lines.zh: : 宿舍战争目前才完成 30%%，Miku。我们有的是时间翻盘。

lines.en: scene mikuyasutrivia42
: And you’ve got plenty’a time to mount a horse’s wiener, Makoto! You ain’t the one who lost in a rigged game! I’ve got everythin’ to be mad about! Stop the steal!
lines.zh: : 你他妈倒是还有大把时间去骑马的鸡巴，Makoto！在一场被操纵的比赛里输掉的人可不是你！我有一万个理由生气！停止偷窃！

lines.en: scene black
: Hm? What? What happened? Is the game over? I thought I heard someone mention-
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？怎么了？比赛结束了吗？我好像听到有人提到——

lines.en: : And you can go mount one with her! Miku Maruyama — out! I’m gonna go hang out with Io!
lines.zh: : 你也可以跟她一起去骑！Miku Maruyama——退场！我要去找 Io 了！

lines.en: : Aww, yay! Here’s hoping she isn’t over-medicated again!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，好耶！希望她这次没又吃药过量！
